name: 11720 · Centereach, NY
findings: ZIP 11720 (Centereach) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11720 (Centereach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
